description: Open-source headless e-commerce framework for Node.js: GraphQL-first API, MongoDB-backed modular core, adapter-based plugin system, built-in MCP server for AI agents, and Admin UI. EUPL-1.2.
rules: Relative imports must include the .ts file extension (import seed from './seed.ts')
Import workspace packages by name without extensions (import { startPlatform } from '@unchainedshop/platform')
Import plugin presets and plugin subpaths WITHOUT a file extension — the package exports map appends .js itself

Register plugins before startPlatform(): presets via registerAllPlugins()/registerBasePlugins()/registerCryptoPlugins(), individual plugins via pluginRegistry.register(SomePlugin) from @unchainedshop/core
startPlatform({}) needs no modules argument for built-in core modules
Never import @unchainedshop/mongodb outside core-* and infrastructure packages; the API layer uses module APIs from core packages
